x_snc_airop_check_definition.ai_justification: DEX survey data provides the qualitative user sentiment signal that complements device and application metrics. Without survey data, DEX AI is missing the human experience dimension needed for complete digital experience analysis.
x_snc_airop_check_definition.remediation_guidance: Configure DEX surveys via dex_survey_configuration_list.do to collect user sentiment data. Survey responses provide qualitative context that DEX AI uses alongside quantitative metrics for a complete picture of employee digital experience.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[DEX survey data provides the qualitative user sentiment signal that complements device and application metrics. Without survey data, DEX AI is missing the human experience dimension needed for complete digital experience analysis.]]></ai_justification><check_name>DEX Survey Configuration</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(checkDef, dateFilter) {
    var ga = new GlideAggregate('dex_survey_configuration');
    ga.addQuery('active', true);
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
    ga.query();
    var count = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT')) : 0;

    var actualValue = count + ' active DEX survey configuration(s)';

    if (count >= 3) {
        return {
            status: 'ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: count + ' active DEX survey configurations. User sentiment data is being collected — DEX AI has qualitative context to complement device and application health metrics.'
        };
    } else if (count >= 1) {
        return {
            status: 'needs_attention',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'Only ' + count + ' active DEX survey configuration(s) (target: 3+). Limited sentiment coverage — configure surveys for additional device and application scenarios.'
        };
    } else {
        return {
            status: 'not_ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'No active DEX survey configurations. User sentiment data is not being collected — DEX AI is missing the qualitative dimension needed for comprehensive digital experience analysis.'
        };
    }
})]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>DEX</module><number>CHK0003338</number><order/><remediation_guidance>Configure DEX surveys via dex_survey_configuration_list.do to collect user sentiment data.
